title: Flexible university schedules
question: Some universities are considering flexible schedules that let students choose between online and classroom sessions each week. Discuss the advantages and disadvantages of this arrangement and give your own opinion.

title: Public transport priorities
question: A city has enough money to improve either its bus network or its bicycle infrastructure, but not both at the same time. Which investment should receive priority? Give reasons for your answer.

title: Smartphones in classrooms
question: Some schools allow students to use smartphones during lessons for research and collaborative tasks, while others prohibit them. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.

title: The four-day working week
question: Many employers are exploring a four-day working week with the same total number of hours. Do the advantages of this change outweigh the disadvantages?

title: Supermarket food waste
question: Supermarkets should be required to donate unsold food that is still safe to eat instead of throwing it away. To what extent do you agree or disagree?

title: Urban community gardens
question: Cities should turn some unused public land into community gardens rather than use it for additional parking. Discuss the benefits and possible drawbacks of this policy.

title: Community service before graduation
question: Some people believe that university students should complete a period of community service before graduating. Discuss the advantages and disadvantages of this requirement.

title: Translation tools and language learning
question: Instant translation tools make communication easier, but some people think they reduce the motivation to learn languages. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.

title: Work experience at secondary school
question: Secondary schools should offer every student a short period of supervised work experience before they finish their studies. Do you agree or disagree?

title: Cultural festivals and tourism
question: Local governments often use cultural festivals to attract visitors. Is this a positive way to support small-town economies, or can it cause more problems than benefits?

title: Repairing electronic products
question: Manufacturers should make electronic products easier and cheaper to repair. What are the reasons for this view, and what problems could it create?

title: Digital services in public libraries
question: Public libraries should spend more money on digital services than on printed books. Discuss both sides and give your own opinion.
